sentences.text: During interrogation, the accused named in the FIR disclosed that the vehicle was procured by them in order to sell the same at Nagaland.

It was also unearthed during investigation that the accused named in the FIR in connivance with the accomplices used to purchase luxurious goods and used to take vehicles in names of various persons by preparing forged documents after procuring loan from a private finance company.
Thereafter, after paying 2 or 3 installments, the accused named in the FIR used to sell the vehicles at Nagaland and thereafter, fraudulently they used to claim the insurance money of the vehicles.

Notices were issued against the petitioner by the IO,
under Section 160 CrPC and Section 41(A) CrPC, in connection with this case.
The petitioner appeared before the IO and his statement was recorded.
Now, the Police is Page No.# 3/4 again searching for the petitioner and he is apprehending arrest.
5. I have perused the Case Diary.
6. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
7. The merits of this case are not brought to the fore, as this case is still under investigation.
8. I have considered the progress of investigation.
9. The petitioner has pledged to cooperate with the remaining part of investigation.
The petitioner is willing to abide by any stringent conditions, if imposed upon him.
10. It appears that anticipatory bail can be granted to the petitioner.
11. Considering all aspects and in view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

In the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-, with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, under the conditions that:-
i) the petitioner shall appear before the IO within 10 (ten) days from today and cooperate with the investigation,
ii) the petitioner shall refrain from such activities with which he is alleged, Page No.#
4/4 iii) the petitioner shall not exercise threats to the witnesses, and iii) the petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court, without prior permission, till completion of investigation.
On breach of any of the bail conditions, the bail order shall stand cancelled.
12. In terms of the above observations, the Anticipatory Bail Application stands disposed of.
